tagline: Autonomous on-chain arbitrage and high-frequency trading MCP server.
description: Binance Agent OS is a production-grade Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that empowers AI agents to autonomously manage Binance Spot and Futures trading. It provides an embedded execution environment featuring secure EIP-712 payload signing, real-time market data APIs, and a deterministic arbitrage detector. Built for seamless integration with Cursor, Claude, and standalone agent runners, Binance Agent OS transforms LLMs into capable crypto-economic actors.
